# Fallout series on Amazon Prime starts earlier: On the night of April 11th

![Fallout series on Amazon Prime starts earlier: On the night of April 11th](/uploads/332_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

We are all very excited about the new Fallout series, which will air exclusively on Amazon Prime. As announced, all episodes of the first season will be available upon release.

Instead of being released on April 11th at 7 p.m., the series will now be published on the **night of April 11th at 3 a.m.**. More precisely, in the announcement it is April 10th, 2024 at 6pm PT, which, converted into the German time zone, is April 11th, 2024 at 3am.

This was announced a few hours ago on Walt Goggins' official X (formerly Twitter) account @falloutprime. Release announcement on X.

You can already watch the series: Save it to your Prime Watchlist now *
